{{Top}}
A '''picket ship''' was a type of military [[Starship/Legends|spaceship]]. [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] [[Vengeance Battle Group|battle group]] included about twenty picket ships.
